purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 436 Padang (city code 3262); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Padang (ATR/BPN) and Geoportal Kota Padang
registryBasis: Padang’s local ATR/BPN Land Office is identified on the official kot-padang.atrbpn.go.id portal. The city Geoportal is a public JIGN/GeoNode service, but its anonymous datasets API currently returns one dataset titled “Peta Area Terdampak Banjir Sumatera,” not a cadastral layer. The BPN public app HTML is only a JavaScript shell; no parcel schema or geometry route was exposed in the inspected HTML/static client.

officialSources.observation: City Geoportal identifies itself as a JIGN data-sharing portal. Direct anonymous GET returned HTTP 200.

Anonymous GeoNode datasets API returned HTTP 200 with total=1: “Peta Area Terdampak Banjir Sumatera” (EPSG:4326). It is flood-impact mapping, not cadastral parcel data. Adding q=tanah returned the same listing.

Official Padang ATR/BPN local-office app root returned HTTP 200 (6,855 bytes) with a JS application shell. Its two public JS bundles also returned HTTP 200 and exposed no map/cadastral service or geometry schema path.
Official Padang city open-data portal. Search pages for bidang tanah, persil, pertanahan and tanah returned “No datasets found”; this catalog search was not treated as parcel geometry.

Padang ATR/BPN’s indexed local-office news item identifies the Kantor Pertanahan Kota Padang. Direct page GET returned the same JS shell as the office portal; the rendered article is not a geometry source.

accessReview.reason: The city GeoPortal datasets endpoint returned a single flood-impact dataset, and the public ATR/BPN app returned only its JavaScript shell; static client bundles contained no parcel service or geometry schema route. A similarly named map candidate at atrbpnpadang.com initially displayed an extent around Bangka (lat -3.231 to -2.460, lon 105.664 to 106.957), not Padang, so it was not treated as a city source and its feature file was not fetched.
